x-changelog.summary: Add field length validation for insurance fields
x-changelog.description:
Added validation to prevent StringDataRightTruncation errors when creating or updating 
company vendor insurances. The following fields now have a maximum length of 255 characters:
- name (insurance provider name)
- policy_number
- insurance_type

When these fields exceed 255 characters, the API will now return a 422 Unprocessable Entity 
response with a descriptive error message instead of a 500 Internal Server Error.
